title: Video shows scene of Bedford train crash as passenger describes aftermath
originalTitle: Video shows scene of Bedford train crash as passenger describes aftermath
content:
Emergency services are at the scene of a collision involving two trains in the Bedford area, British Transport Police has confirmed.

Operator East Midlands Railway has said two of its trains were involved in the crash.

Footage taken from the scene shows where the two trains collided and passengers who appear to have been evacuated.

Speaking to the BBC, passenger Pete Knapp said the crash "felt like [he'd] been in a bomb explosion".

More on this story.
